term.label: Penelope_retrotransposon

definition.text: Penelope is a subclass of non_LTR_retrotransposons (SO:0000189). Penelope retrotransposons contains structural features of TR, RT, EN, TR, terminal repeats which can be in tandem or inverse orientation in different Penelope copies. RT is reverse transcriptase. EN is endonuclease.

comments: Added as per GitHub Issue Request #488 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/488)
